title: Rust: Simple Testing Framework
description: Build a simple testing framework with assertions and test runner.

steps.title: Assertion Macros
steps.description: Write functions `assert_eq<T: Display + PartialEq>(left: T, right: T, msg: &str)` and `assert_true(value: bool, msg: &str)`. Each prints a colored pass/fail message.
hints: On fail: `println!("  ✗ {}", msg); println!("    expected: {}, got: {}", right, left)`
These are like Rust's assert_eq! but with custom formatting.

verification.failureMessage: Run assert_eq(1, 1, "one equals one") and print the result.

steps.title: Test Function Runner
steps.description: Create a `TestSuite` that holds test functions: `Vec<Box<dyn Fn()>>`. Add a `run()` method that executes all tests and prints a summary (passed, failed, total).
hints: `struct TestSuite { tests: Vec<(String, Box<dyn Fn()>)>, failures: usize, passes: usize }`
Wrap each test in `std::panic::catch_unwind` to capture panics.
Print `"3/3 tests passed"` at the end.

verification.failureMessage: Run a TestSuite with passing tests and print summary.

steps.title: Test Setup and Teardown
steps.description: Add setup/teardown support: `before_each: Option<Box<dyn Fn()>>` and `after_each: Option<Box<dyn Fn()>>`. The setup runs before each test, teardown after. Print setup/teardown messages.
hints: In `run()`, call `setup()` before each test, `teardown()` after.

verification.failureMessage: Run tests with setup and teardown, print messages.

steps.title: Test Grouping
steps.description: Add test grouping: create a `TestGroup` with a name and child tests. Support nested groups. Print an indented hierarchy when running tests.
hints: `struct TestGroup { name: String, tests: Vec<Box<dyn Testable>>, groups: Vec<TestGroup> }`
Implement `Testable` trait for both tests and groups.

Print with indentation: `  Group: math
    ✓ test_add
    ✓ test_sub`

verification.failureMessage: Define and run nested test groups.

steps.title: Timing and Performance Tests
steps.description: Add test timing: measure and print the duration of each test. Add a `should_complete_under(duration: Duration)` assertion that fails if the test takes too long.
hints: Record `Instant::now()` before and after each test.
`assert_completes_under(threshold, || { /* code */ })` returns Err if too slow.

verification.failureMessage: Run tests with timing information and print durations.
